The intake's place in the calendar shape matters now that Sasha has surfaced a new lens on platform readiness.

Carlos's input landed late morning, closing the on-time set at six of eight — Aisha will register and not celebrate; the head-space she'd normally apply to Hannah-and-Roman is partly taken by the September-hip-surgery question her mother asked her to think about.
